build.buildCommand: curl -sSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash -s -- --channel 10.0 && export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH" && cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && mkdir -p ../backend/wwwroot && cp -r dist/* ../backend/wwwroot/ && cd ../backend && $HOME/.dotnet/dotnet publish -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained true -o out
